orbs.title: Aspects and orbs
orbs.intro: Which aspects your charts show and how far from exact they may be. Charts are recalculated with the new orbs when they are next opened; earlier versions, and chart snapshots on consultations, stay as they were.
orbs.luminaryBonus: Extra orb for the Sun and Moon (°)
orbs.luminaryBonusHint: Added when either of them takes part.

transitOrbs.title: Transit orbs
transitOrbs.intro: How close to exact a transit to the natal chart must be to count — much tighter than between natal points. Transits are calculated each time they are opened, so a change applies at once.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.intro: Emails go to you, never to your clients. Times follow your time zone ({zone}), set under Regional.
notifications.remindersHint: An email before each appointment. Each appointment can have its own time, or none.
notifications.digestHint: One email in the morning with how many tasks are due that day, if any — tasks marked “Remind me”.
notifications.quietHint: No email in this stretch. A reminder that falls in it goes out when it ends — or just before it begins, if the appointment starts first.
notifications.private: Emails stay generic: the time and a link, never a client’s name or a task title. The details open after you sign in.
notifications.testIntro: Sends a message to {email} the same way reminders go, to check that email reaches you.
notifications.testQueued: Test email on its way to {email}

rectified.hint: Full chart, marked as a rectified time.

approximate.label: Approximate
approximate.hint: Full chart, with a warning that angles and houses are unreliable.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.hint: Planets only, for 12:00 UT. No angles or houses; the Moon is shown as a range.

warnings.skipped: This time did not exist: clocks went forward that night. Check the time, or whether the record used the old time.

warnings.zoneHistory: Time-zone records before 1970 are unreliable in some regions. Check the offset if the chart looks wrong.

chart.title: Natal chart
chart.unavailable: Charts cannot be calculated right now. Everything else keeps working.
chart.moonRange: Time unknown: the Moon moved through this span during the birth date.
chart.noonNote: Positions for 12:00 UT on the birth date. Angles and houses need a birth time; the Moon is drawn as the span it covered that day, and its aspects are left out.
chart.approximateNote: The birth time is approximate: angles and house cusps are shown, but do not lean on them. Four minutes of clock time move the Ascendant by about a degree.
chart.rectifiedNote: Rectified birth time. Earlier calculations are kept.
chart.fallback: {requested} houses cannot be drawn at {latitude}, inside the polar circle: some degrees of the zodiac never rise or set there. {used} is shown instead.
chart.wholeSignNote: Whole Sign houses: the first house begins at 0° {sign}, not at the Ascendant, which falls inside the first house.
chart.oldSnapshot: Taken before angles, houses and aspects were calculated: positions only.

sky.title: Sky calendar
sky.sub: The sky itself, nobody’s chart: aspects between the planets with the minute each one is exact, stations, ingresses, new and full moons.
sky.emptyText: Choose a longer period, or clear a filter.
sky.sidereal: Sidereal zodiac ({ayanamsa}): signs and ingresses follow it; aspects are the same in either zodiac.
sky.arcsIntro: When a planet turns round, the same aspect can be exact two or three times over nearly the same degree. Passes up to a year either side of the period are shown with it.
sky.arcsNone: No aspect in this period comes back in a retrograde loop.
